scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: Haskell algebraic type and pattern matching
checks.code:
data Shape = Circle Int | Rectangle Int Int
area :: Shape -> Int
area (Circle r) = 3 * r * r
area (Rectangle w h) = w * h
main :: IO ()
main = print (area (Rectangle 3 4))

checks.name: Haskell multiline UTF-8 stdin
Haskell type error prevents execution
checks.code:
main :: IO ()
main = do putStrLn "MUST_NOT_RUN"; print ((1 :: Int) + "wrong")

result.compilerStderr:

    • Couldn't match type ‘[Char]’ with ‘Int’
      Expected: Int
        Actual: String
    • In the second argument of ‘(+)’, namely ‘"wrong"’
      In the first argument of ‘print’, namely ‘((1 :: Int) + "wrong")’
      In a stmt of a 'do' block: print ((1 :: Int) + "wrong")
  |
2 | main = do putStrLn "MUST_NOT_RUN"; print ((1 :: Int) + "wrong")
  |                                                        ^^^^^^^

checks.name: Haskell handled IO exception succeeds
checks.code:
import Control.Exception (catch)
handler :: IOError -> IO ()
handler _ = putStrLn "handled"
main :: IO ()
main = catch (ioError (userError "expected")) handler
